scenario: Kwarg modifier list rejects duplicate modifiers (DS_PARSE_KWARG_MODIFIER_DUPLICATE, [LGRA.23.2]). Pin: `kwarg x: Int required required` rejects because `required` is stacked twice. The same name appearing twice means the author mistakenly stacked the same flag. Service decl lives in the rule file so the parse-time error surfaces directly.
rules_ds:
service svc.foo:
    kwarg x: Int required required
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
